## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the concrete problem, the final behavior and any related issue or milestone.

## Validation

List exact commands and observed results. Label BUILD, HOST/FIXTURE, NATIVE or NETWORK-REAL evidence separately. Mark unavailable checks NOT RUN and state the prerequisite. Do not claim original-game acceptance from fixture tests.

## Limitations and review notes

Explain remaining limitations, compatibility impact and any evidence reviewers should inspect.

## Before submitting

- [ ] The change is focused and follows CONTRIBUTING.md and the project scope.
- [ ] Relevant checks and documentation are included, with unavailable checks explicitly recorded.
- [ ] The patch contains no game binaries/assets, saves, credentials, invitations or private diagnostic exports.
- [ ] Player-visible launcher changes include matching release notes, changelog and version updates, or this does not apply.
